item.title: Running Path of Exile 2 Simulations: Essence
item.description: The Backstory: Why I Did This #I’ve been playing this new game for a month now (Path of Exile 2) and to tackle the hardest content, you need really good gear, and to get that gear, you need a ton of in-game currency.
